claims.text: Updating profiles
claims.note: Tile title. The column is "Update from Current".

claims.text: Amend a profile without reapplying it.
claims.note: Tile summary. Update from Current does not apply the profile unless Apply Profile is also staged.

claims.text: Fold this week’s adjustments back into a saved profile without applying it to the course.
claims.note: Update from Current replaces the slot's stored targets with the course's current targets, all of them (SpatialAdjustService.cs:636-678). "Adjustments" here means target edits; % Adj. values are not stored.

claims.text: Settings › Target Profiles
claims.note: Settings gear, then the third rail entry.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab lists five named profile slots for each Lynx course.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (updating-profiles/note/1); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Target Profiles is still in development and is not in the shipping build yet.

claims.text: If your settings dialog has no Target Profiles entry, your IntelliDash has not yet been updated to the release that includes it.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (updating-profiles/note/2); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The screens here show a proposed design; the tab being built lists five named profile slots, so what you see on your own screen may differ.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: A saved profile whose targets you have since changed in the table.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/1/2, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Updating a profile rewrites what it stores.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; 373-1135 rev 02 predates Target Profiles. The stored stations are deleted and replaced (SpatialAdjustService.cs:642-678).

claims.text: It does not change any station until the profile is applied.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. Update reads stations without writing them (SpatialAdjustService.cs:566-580); only the apply step writes targets (:681-692).

claims.text: Notice the drift
claims.note: Step title. The product signals the drift: the "<name> Target Profile" label above the table disappears at the first target edit (sa-dashboard.component.ts:326-332).

claims.text: Look above the table for the name of the profile you applied.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim updating-profiles/2/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: After a fortnight of individual target edits, the course no longer matches the profile you applied.

claims.text: After any station target edit, the name is gone, because the course no longer matches the profile.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/1/2, updating-profiles/2/2, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The profile is still valid, it is simply out of date.

claims.text: If the name is still there, no target has changed since you applied it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/2/2, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: There is nothing to update.
claims.note: While the name shows, no target has changed since the profile was applied, so the stored profile and the course agree. Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/2/2, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The stored profile is not changed by those edits; it is simply out of date.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/1/3, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Individually edited targets drift away from the profile.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Open Settings
At the right of the toolbar, select the gear button, [[Settings]].
claims.note: The gear button has tooltip STRINGS.SETTINGS "Settings" and opens the Settings dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72).
claims.previousText: The profile last applied is named above the dashboard table until a station target is edited; the profile list does not mark it.

claims.text: The Settings dialog opens, with a rail of tabs down its left side.
claims.previousText: Editing a station target after applying leaves the profile intact but no longer exactly matched.

claims.text: If another dialog is open, close it first.
claims.note: Dialogs here are modal (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:3), so a second dialog cannot be reached while one is open.

claims.text: The gear is just right of [[Announcements]].
The gear button sits in the toolbar’s right-hand group.
Open the Target Profiles tab
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/1/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: In the left rail, select [[Target Profiles]], below [[Minimum Threshold]].
claims.note: The rail lists Calculation, Minimum Threshold, Target Profiles, then Preferences (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims target-profiles/note/1, target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Overwrite the stored targets with the current ones when the drift is an improvement.

claims.text: The right side lists 5 profile slots, with [[Update from Current]] and [[Apply Profile]] columns.
claims.note: Five slots per course, indexes 0 to 4 (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:28-31, sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:383-392). Column headings at sa-settings-dlg.component.html:195-199.
claims.previousText: Capture into a different slot instead when the change is for one event, and rename it to suit; with five slots per course that overwrites whatever the other slot held, so pick one you no longer need.

claims.text: If the rail has no [[Target Profiles]], your IntelliDash predates it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Change targets in the table instead.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Rule of thumb. Update when the course has genuinely moved on.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab in the settings dialog.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/1/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Use another slot when the change is temporary.

claims.text: Find the profile’s row
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (updating-profiles/2/1); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Find the profile in the [[Target Profile]] column.
claims.previousText: Updating a profile writes to the profile, not to the stations.

claims.text: Its row shows when it was last updated and how many stations it holds.
claims.previousText: The Suggested column should be exactly as it was — if it moved, something applied rather than updated.

claims.text: If no name looks right, a slot may have been renamed.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim updating-profiles/2/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A rename also changes its date, which can help.
claims.note: Renaming a slot sets its last-updated time as well as capturing does (SpatialAdjustService.cs:625-627), so the Last Updated column moves with a rename.

claims.text: The list does not mark which profile was applied, so go by its name.
claims.note: The profile table has name, Last Updated, Stations and the two icon columns and no applied marker; the only exclamation is the pending-on-save flag (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:203-219).

claims.text: The profile’s row, with Update from Current.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (updating-profiles/2/4); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The active profile, ready to be updated.

claims.text: Update this slot or capture into another
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (updating-profiles/3/1); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: On the profile’s row, select the icon under [[Update from Current]].
An exclamation mark appears on the icon: the slot will take the current targets when you save.
claims.note: The icon shows an exclamation with tooltip "Will update on save" once the slot is marked (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:210).

claims.text: If the mark goes away, you selected the icon twice.
claims.note: onUpdateTargetProfile flips updateFromCurrent on each selection (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:249-251).

claims.text: Select it once more.
For a one-off event, capture into a spare slot instead, so this profile stays as it is.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/3/3, updating-profiles/3/6; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Updating overwrites the stored targets in place.
claims.note: Figure caption. The stored rows are deleted and replaced (SpatialAdjustService.cs:642-678).

claims.text: Save the change
Select [[Save Changes]] at the bottom of the dialog.
A busy sign shows while the profile is saved, then the dialog closes.
If the dialog stays open with [[Unable to save data]], the save did not finish.
claims.note: On error onSave shows the generic save error, GENERIC_SAVE_ERROR_SUMMARY "Unable to save data", and does not emit save, so the dialog stays open (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-213).

claims.text: Reload the page and check the profile list before you try again.
claims.note: The profile operation can fail or time out after ten minutes with advice to refresh before trying again (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:510-518); a failed save does not reload the list, so reloading is the way to see what was stored.

claims.text: Nothing is captured until Save Changes.
Confirm nothing moved
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: In the table, read [[Target VWC]] and [[Suggested]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/4/2, updating-profiles/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: They are as they were.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/4/3, updating-profiles/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The update changed only the stored profile.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/4/2, updating-profiles/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If they changed, the save did more, such as applying a profile or changing a calculation setting.
claims.note: A save can also carry settings changes that recalculate adjustments or an applied profile, which reload the dashboard (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:528-561). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim updating-profiles/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Suggestions unchanged: the update touched only the stored profile.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: The profile’s last-updated date is today.
claims.note: Last Updated is stamped on Update from Current (SpatialAdjustService.cs:625).

claims.text: No station target or suggestion changed.
claims.note: Provided Apply Profile was not staged in the same save.
